correctness_confidence.basis: The paper provides an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (EnvyFreeFiveAgents.lean) with 0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice, and 4 zero-axiom theorems, alongside an exact-Q zero-float Python verifier with 16 canonical certificates. All algebraic identities and Hall ceiling inequalities are rigorously checked.

novelty.basis: First machine-checked formalization and exact-Q certificate auditing architecture for five-agent contiguous envy-free cake cutting, bridging recent breakthrough combinatorial protocols with formal verification and exact arithmetic.

reproducibility.basis: Complete reproducibility ensured via deterministic script execution, 16 canonical exact-Q JSON certificates, and zero-float Python verifier passing all independent cross-checks and red-team adversarial forgeries.

rigor.basis: Exhaustive verification of anchor geometry, gap closure, strict Hall-ceiling margins (9p-8 > 8(p-1)), connected bipartite favorite graphs with 32,000 spanning trees, strongly hungry perturbations, and query complexity bounds.

significance.basis: Establishes a rigorous, cryptographic manifest-locked verification paradigm for complex combinatorial fair division protocols, eliminating floating-point rounding drift hazards and establishing new standards for algorithmic game theory formalization.

potential_errors: The formalization explicitly scopes out real-analytic IVT existence proofs over arbitrary Lipschitz black-box valuation oracles, leaving full oracle-access integration to future Mathlib extensions.
strengths: Zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel with 18 machine-checked theorems, 0 sorry, and 0 warnings.
Pure Python exact-Q zero-float certificate verifier auditing four distinct modes across 16 heterogeneous benchmarks.
Comprehensive red-team audit suite with 54/54 adversarial forgeries successfully rejected.
Rigorous treatment of strict Hall-ceiling margins, spanning tree counts (32,000 for K_{5,4}), and polylog query complexity separation.
strong_novelty_candidates: Zero-float exact-rational certificate auditing architecture (ENVY-FREE-5-CERT-1.0) for multi-agent fair division protocols.
Machine-checked EnvyFreeFiveAgents.lean core covering Hall robustness and Lemma 3.9 ceiling inequalities without external library dependencies.
summary: The paper presents a machine-checked exact-rational formalization and certificate auditing architecture for the five-agent contiguous envy-free cake-cutting protocol of Filos-Ratsikas et al. (2026). It combines an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel with a pure-stdlib exact-Q Python verifier, validating 16 canonical certificates across heterogeneous benchmarks and rejecting 54 adversarial forgeries.
weaknesses: Results are restricted to piecewise-constant rational valuations and finite certificate instances rather than general continuous black-box valuation oracles.
